t: Southwark Towers stood here, at 32 London Bridge Street, overlooking London Bridge station. It was a high-rise designed by TP Bennett architects. It was demolished in 2008 to make way for The Shard, and at the time it was jointly the tallest building ever demolished in the United Kingdom, alongside the Drapers' Gardens tower. The firm is linked to Sir Thomas Bennett, who was responsible for much of the development of the new towns of Crawley and Stevenage.
